name: darya
description: Darya - a bilingual Persian/English calm conversation companion. Fully offline: static HTML/CSS/JS, no build step, no backend.

scripts.test: node --test --test-reporter tap tests/ambient-sound.test.mjs tests/engine.test.mjs tests/foundation.test.mjs tests/knowledge-world.test.mjs tests/language.test.mjs tests/quality.test.mjs tests/time-utils.test.mjs tests/engine-regression.test.mjs tests/persona-conversations.test.mjs tests/context-memory-conversations.test.mjs tests/mixed-topic-sessions.test.mjs tests/media-intelligence.test.mjs tests/recent-life-intelligence.test.mjs tests/wild-conversations.test.mjs tests/wild-daily-2026.test.mjs tests/wild-passions-2026.test.mjs tests/bump-version.test.mjs
scripts.test:full: npm run lint && npm run lint:css && npm run format:check && npm test
scripts.android:add: npm run sync:web && npx cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run sync:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.test:e2e: node --test --test-reporter tap tests/e2e-keyboard.test.mjs tests/e2e-offline-sw.test.mjs tests/e2e-quick-replies.test.mjs tests/e2e-sound-attention.test.mjs
